scope: Final independent sandbox workflow prose and Claude README supplement

machines.name: Sandbox command routing and five-phase operator workflow
machines.explicitness: Explicit five-phase BLOCK instructions; implicit command handoff and lifetime rules. No durable workflow-state record identified in these prose files.
machines.state_storage: Conversation-level phase, requested source/policy/box ID, external driver observations and explicit keep-volume choice; runtime states remain owned by S47–S54

transitions.guard: one of five namespaced sandbox commands invoked
transitions.effects: Load invoked command body and sandbox-lifecycle instructions; catalog prescribes lazy routing rather than bulk context loading.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing owner/prerequisite sources instruct STOP; no fallback workflow is defined.

transitions.guard: mount/run/network source files accessible at plugin root
transitions.effects: Read actual mount, isolation and network seams before choosing operations.
transitions.failure_retry: If files cannot be read, STOP and surface gap; source comments alone do not prove live container state.

transitions.guard: docker info returns nonzero
transitions.effects: Report Docker unavailable and do not clone/build.
transitions.failure_retry: Repair availability and retry admission; no guessed capability.

transitions.guard: nixpacks absent
transitions.effects: Command and skill prescribe STOP plus install hint.
transitions.failure_retry: Conflicts with documented and implemented Node/Python fallback; SW-F01.

transitions.guard: create request has no URL/local path
transitions.effects: Ask for the source; do not choose a repository on user’s behalf.
transitions.failure_retry: Continue only with named source.

transitions.guard: named source and reachable Docker; no user policy selected
transitions.effects: Prescribe offline default; clone-then-cut or allowlist require named selection.
transitions.failure_retry: Do not infer broader egress. Ordinary driver currently stays offline even for declared richer policy; SW-F05.

transitions.guard: explicit selection and user acknowledges experimental status
transitions.effects: Label experimental each time and retain explicit acknowledgement requirement from skill.
transitions.failure_retry: Without acknowledgement phase remains BLOCK. This is model-guided permission instruction, not proof runtime implements ordinary allowlist.

transitions.guard: explicit option; never ordinary default
transitions.effects: Route to separate sandbox-claude-inside owner and its token/source separation rules.
transitions.failure_retry: Do not combine token and untrusted-source volume or start credential path implicitly.

transitions.guard: phase 1 gates passed; no credential path bypass
transitions.effects: Invoke createSandbox/build owner; require source volume at /work/repo and dependencies at /deps.
transitions.failure_retry: No hand-rolled docker run or source-over-dependency mount; failed build blocks next phase.

transitions.guard: skill presumes stable repo/hash tag and existing image
transitions.effects: Prescribe no rebuild and identical tag.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing S49/SF08 shows create uses random temporary basename in tag; this is a documented promise, not current achieved cross-create reuse.

transitions.guard: driver runContainer and mount builder used; declared isolation set retained
transitions.effects: Prescribe no bind/socket/privileged mode, non-root/read-only root/no-new-privileges/resource limits and labeled resources.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing required isolation rejects run; this prose does not specify compensation after a failed inspect.

transitions.guard: no bind mount/socket and Privileged is false
transitions.effects: Report sandbox ID and interaction commands.
transitions.failure_retry: Any forbidden property is a non-overridable rejection described as a driver bug.

transitions.guard: running ca.sandbox=1 container matching supplied ID exists
transitions.effects: Select existing box; add no mount/socket/privilege.
transitions.failure_retry: Absent or stopped box => STOP; no implicit creation.

transitions.guard: non-root interactive shell at /work/repo
transitions.effects: Attach shell without root elevation, writable-root remount or new resources.
transitions.failure_retry: Interactive terminal limitations/failure are not further specified by prose.

transitions.guard: normal shell session closes
transitions.effects: Return to host; sandbox-shell explicitly says box lives until sandbox-destroy.
transitions.failure_retry: Contradicts lifecycle’s session-close teardown trigger; do not silently choose either disposition.

transitions.guard: close of interactive session treated as exit
transitions.effects: Lifecycle prescribes destroying container and default source volume on close.
transitions.failure_retry: Contradicts command body’s persistent box; SW-F02 requires one owner-defined lifetime.

transitions.guard: argv after --; existing running labeled box
transitions.effects: Invoke execInSandbox and report real exitCode, separated stdout/stderr and truncated flag.
transitions.failure_retry: Nonzero may not be collapsed into success. Runtime interruption/overflow containment is separately S52/SF09.

transitions.guard: container source and explicit host destination
transitions.effects: Invoke cpOut/docker cp outward and report destination.
transitions.failure_retry: Host-inbound copy/mount or writable host path for container is prohibited by instruction; no claim of transactional copy rollback.

transitions.event: request elevation, host bind/socket or token/source co-mount
transitions.guard: request would violate structural boundary
transitions.effects: Prescribe refusal rather than changing isolation or routing around mount builder.
transitions.failure_retry: Use allowed operation/source-only or token-only workflow; no override path provided.

transitions.guard: explicit single-box request
transitions.effects: Route to destroySandbox for selected container and its named volume.
transitions.failure_retry: Command also lists an unqualified prune step/global-empty invariant; runtime S53 distinguishes targets from unrelated objects. SW-F03.

transitions.guard: sweep operation selected
transitions.effects: Find and reclaim ca.sandbox=1 resources by label, never other objects.
transitions.failure_retry: Do not infer this broad sweep from a different operation’s failure or a request naming only one box.

transitions.guard: explicit retention requested
transitions.effects: Remove container while retaining selected volume and cached images.
transitions.failure_retry: Retained selected volume is intentional; persistence choice does not authorize other leftover resources.

transitions.guard: driver failure/remaining targeted object returned
transitions.effects: Name leftovers, surface failure and nonzero outcome; do not stop remaining independent removal attempts.
transitions.failure_retry: Retry/re-observe existing target identities; runtime S53 owns bounded details and verified absence.

transitions.event: observed absence and no removal errors
transitions.guard: scope empty excluding explicit kept volumes/images
transitions.effects: Report resources removed and intentional retained resources.
transitions.failure_retry: Documentation’s global-zero wording must be narrowed to selected scope for single-ID destroy; no automatic unrelated-box cleanup.

machines.notes: These are instructions to the host model. Docker process, image, mount, network, copy and destroy mechanics are not recounted as new machines; see S47–S54. Conflicting instruction edges are preserved explicitly rather than reconciled by assumption.

machines.name: Claude-inside credential workflow and five BLOCK phases
machines.explicitness: Explicit five-phase BLOCK instructions; implicit command handoff and lifetime rules. No durable workflow-state record identified in these prose files.
machines.state_storage: Conversation-level gate evidence, policy/image/token-source declarations, home-volume choice and external runtime observations; no phase-completion receipt consumed by the separate CLI

transitions.guard: consumer PROJECT_DIR has both named sandbox spike files and ADR 0007
transitions.effects: Read those exact project-relative files before proceeding.
transitions.failure_retry: Missing required file instructs STOP. Skill supplies no packaged-reference fallback; SW-F07.

transitions.guard: operator follows prescribed skill route
transitions.effects: Use separate claude-inside.js entrypoint rather than sandbox subcommand.
transitions.failure_retry: Binary separation is routing/discoverability, not mechanical verification that five prose phases occurred; SW-F08.

transitions.guard: named offline or anthropic-only policy and explicit token-only boundary
transitions.effects: Default offline; label Anthropic-only experimental; state that this box carries token and no untrusted source.
transitions.failure_retry: Wide-open/third policy rejected; token+source request stops and must be split into distinct boxes.

transitions.guard: pinned Claude CLI SemVer, DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, reviewed digest-pinned node base
transitions.effects: Prescribe image construction and version/base inspection through driver builder.
transitions.failure_retry: Floating CLI/base fails model-guided gate; arbitrary --image acceptance is not evidence of completed qualification.

transitions.guard: reviewed dependency change selected
transitions.effects: Prescribe digest resolution and credential-boundary/isolation-suite rerun.
transitions.failure_retry: Previous Spike/ADR is historical evidence; does not automatically qualify changed image.

transitions.guard: approved-store OAuth token available in scoped environment; no argv/bind/log/prompt exposure
transitions.effects: Pass CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN by environment only.
transitions.failure_retry: Do not invent missing token or store approval; --token/source-volume flags are separately rejected by actual CLI.

transitions.guard: HOME backed by named volume, not host bind
transitions.effects: Prescribe writable in-container home and retention across restart when same volume reused.
transitions.failure_retry: Persistence description does not establish an observed authenticated session; no live host was exercised in this audit.

transitions.guard: builder-generated argv; no sourceVolume; named policy and isolation requirements
transitions.effects: Invoke buildClaudeRunArgs/runClaudeInside with token-only home volume; offline or experimental firewall policy.
transitions.failure_retry: Co-mount rejection is structural; additional phase evidence remains model-guided.

transitions.guard: instruction requires a real Invalid bearer token 401 before real credential use
transitions.effects: Prescribe observing auth-boundary failure with dummy credentials.
transitions.failure_retry: Offline default cannot itself make a network request; the text does not specify how offline launch and prior/networked qualification evidence are separated. Do not silently weaken isolation to satisfy proof.

transitions.guard: all model-guided gates judged satisfied
transitions.effects: Report usable token-only box according to driver outcome.
transitions.failure_retry: Actual separate CLI validates arguments/token presence and calls runtime; it does not receive a five-phase completion record.

transitions.guard: operation/session ends
transitions.effects: Prescribe remove container and default removal of credential home volume.
transitions.failure_retry: Runtime S51 cleanup/unknown rules must be observed; a failed remove cannot be described as destroyed.

transitions.guard: retention deliberately selected and recorded
transitions.effects: Keep named home volume; remove container; identify retained credential-bearing resource.
transitions.failure_retry: Prose does not define the durable record format; do not fabricate one or treat default retention as authorized.

transitions.guard: container/credential volume absent in selected scope
transitions.effects: Report verified absence and retained cached images only.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown/failing observation blocks success. Global-label wording should not authorize removal of other unrelated active boxes.

transitions.event: new token-only container on same volume
transitions.guard: explicit subsequent run passes posture/image/token gates again
transitions.effects: Instruction expects retained home state/session to be available after restart.
transitions.failure_retry: Existing volume does not waive token/source separation or current policy admission.

machines.notes: The CLI does enforce argument grammar, environment-only token input and no source-volume flag; runtime enforces actual co-mount/isolation controls. Store approval, qualification provenance, phase completion and keep-volume recording are not established solely by placing the executable in a separate file. This classification preserves actual hard stops without adding a new authority mechanism.

findings.title: Sandbox preflight instructions refuse a dependency configuration that README and driver support
findings.claim: sandbox.md and lifecycle hard rules require nixpacks on PATH and STOP if absent. README explicitly allows Node/Python Dockerfile fallback, matching audited S49 fallback behavior. Following the installed workflow can unnecessarily block a supported create.
findings.recommendation: Derive host prerequisites and supported fallback coverage from one driver capability contract. Preserve a hard failure for unsupported stacks; do not require nixpacks when the selected stack has a verified fallback.

findings.status: direct contradiction between fully read command and skill
findings.title: The same shell exit means persistent box in one owner and teardown in another
findings.claim: sandbox-shell explicitly leaves the box running after shell exit until sandbox-destroy. lifecycle Phase 5 and hard rules trigger teardown when the interactive session closes. An agent following both has no unambiguous next action and could delete work the shell command said would persist.
findings.recommendation: Define shell detach versus sandbox destruction as separate events in one lifecycle owner. Preserve current runtime behavior until an intentional lifetime decision is approved; do not add automatic destructive teardown as a documentation cleanup.

findings.status: instruction scope conflict with audited target-aware cleanup
findings.title: Single-box destroy prose drifts into a global prune and global-empty postcondition
findings.claim: The destroy command accepts an explicit box ID but its flow then says prune remaining labeled objects and its hard gate demands zero plugin-labeled containers/volumes. Audited S53 deliberately freezes selected targets and does not retroactively treat unrelated/new resources as failure. Label ownership is broader than the operation’s selected instance.

sources.symbol: targeted destroy and explicit prune; S53

findings.recommendation: Specify a frozen operation target set. A named destroy verifies that instance; explicit prune/no-ID selects the broad labeled set. Report other active boxes separately and never broaden cleanup merely to satisfy global-empty wording.

findings.status: public storage claim contradicted by audited host staging
findings.title: Sandbox docs omit the temporary host copy of cloned source
findings.claim: sandbox.md and lifecycle say cloned code is never on the host filesystem; README says the cloned repo lives inside the container. Audited S48 create copies the checkout from the source volume into a newly named host temp directory for build analysis, then removes it in finally. This contradicts storage-location wording; it does not by itself show that the runtime container has a host bind mount.
findings.recommendation: State runtime mount isolation separately from host-side build staging, including temp location/lifetime/cleanup observations. Keep the no-bind/socket/privileged invariants; do not claim zero host source bytes while staging is implemented.

findings.status: advertised transition unavailable in current ordinary runtime
findings.title: Ordinary sandbox allowlist selection is described as applied although its run path stays offline
findings.claim: Command/skill/README offer ordinary allowlist policy and lifecycle Phase 3 says richer policies are applied by network.ts. Audited S50 finds NETWORKED_POLICIES empty and all ordinary runtime containers use --network none. The standalone helper and separate Claude-inside firewall path do not establish ordinary CLI integration.
findings.recommendation: Expose effective policy and current availability in generated help/instructions. Preserve offline behavior; any new network capability requires its own concrete implementation/verification and policy review.

findings.status: additional affected documentation for existing runtime finding SF08
findings.title: Cache reuse promise is repeated across independent sandbox surfaces
findings.claim: COMMANDS glossary, README, create command and lifecycle all promise identical dependency inputs imply identical tag/cache hit. Existing SF08/S49 identifies random create checkout basenames in the actual tag, defeating that cross-create promise.
findings.related_finding: SF08; no additional runtime defect is asserted
findings.recommendation: Correct stable cache identity once in the driver, then derive the same bounded reuse claim for every surface. Keep cache-hit proof separate from hash equality.

findings.title: Claude-inside requires codeArbiter maintainer evidence under the consumer project root
findings.claim: Preflight says read or STOP for two specific sandbox spike documents and ADR 0007 at CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.codearbiter. There is no packaged-reference fallback in the skill. Therefore a consumer project without those files is directed to stop even when driver/platform requirements are otherwise satisfied; the audit does not assume a particular user project’s files.
findings.recommendation: Ship a concise current prerequisite/capability contract at a plugin-owned path and cite maintainer evidence as commit-bound provenance. Do not require consumers to manufacture/copy internal ADR or historical spike files.

findings.status: prose enforcement claim exceeds executable admission
findings.title: Separate executable placement does not enforce five Claude-inside workflow phases
findings.claim: The skill says separate binary placement IS the gate and calls the five BLOCK phases enforced rather than advice. Fully read runClaudeInsideCli accepts image/home/policy, checks environment token presence, then calls runClaudeInside; it consumes no proof of caller identity, approved store, reviewed image or phase completion. Actual token-argv/source-volume/policy and runtime isolation guards remain real and should be credited individually.
findings.recommendation: Label model-guided checks and mechanically enforced guards accurately. Keep the separate supported entrypoint and real isolation checks; introduce no new mandatory proof/approval mechanism unless a concrete authority design is intentionally approved.

findings.status: README claims compared with fully audited hook owner evidence
findings.title: Claude README overstates dormant behavior and confines repository writes too narrowly
findings.claim: README says hooks immediately do nothing without .codearbiter and repository writes are .codearbiter only. The hook owner confirms session-start.main clears its mode marker and may heal globally owned statusline settings before the active-repository check. Opted-in initialization also installs Git hooks and writes selected Git-common info/exclude and hook bookkeeping outside .codearbiter. These are different scopes and should be stated separately.
findings.recommendation: Document repository enforcement activation separately from host-wide startup maintenance. List Git metadata writes and existing opt-in boundaries. This requires claim correction, not removing useful maintenance or broadening authority.

coverage.additional_read: claude-inside-cli.ts fully read to verify the separate-binary enforcement assertion; its runtime machine is not duplicated.
coverage.cross_owner_runtime_evidence: surfaces.json S47–S54/SF08–SF10 and hook owner full-source reads support cross-surface comparisons. These runtime files are not falsely attributed to this supplement’s own read manifest.
coverage.no_new_tests: No new tests/probes, Docker calls, credentials, model calls, repository edits or external writes.

readme_existing_finding_extension.claim: Additional SessionStart injection wording conflicts with prompt-submit persona owner; add this surface to the existing finding rather than counting another runtime defect.

decision: Use owner-defined transitions/capabilities to generate operational instructions and public claims. Define explicit shell-detach versus destruction and instance versus prune scope. Preserve actual isolation and user authority; distinguish model-guided phases from enforced guards rather than inventing new approval machinery.
